children: Flap’s founder addressed the impact of an incident involving an irregularity with the project’s official website domain. According to ChainCatcher, the risk is limited to users who visited the abnormal site in the tens of minutes before the announcement and connected a wallet or signed an authorization. Users who had previously connected to the FLAP website normally are unaffected and do not need to change their wallet addresses.

The founder said FLAP does not store users’ private keys, seed phrases, or wallet data on its backend. Users should avoid the official website until the issue is resolved; the team will announce when it is back online through its official accounts. Users who recently connected a wallet on the abnormal site can contact the founder by direct message for assistance.

title: Flap Founder Says Risk Is Limited to Users Who Connected Wallets or Signed Approvals on Rogue Site
